remarks:
Opportunity awaits at 760 16th Street! This well-maintained duplex offers an excellent opportunity for investors or owner-occupants looking to offset their mortgage with rental income. Featuring approximately 1,850 square feet of living space, this property includes two spacious 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartments. 

The first-floor apartment features an enclosed front porch, welcoming foyer, bright living room, two generously sized bedrooms, a full bath, and a spacious eat-in kitchen. The second-floor apartment offers a functional layout with two bedrooms, a full bath, a large kitchen, a comfortable living room, a bonus room ideal for a home office, den, or flex space, plus in-unit laundry hookups.

Outside, you’ll find a long private driveway providing ample off-street parking and an oversized backyard with plenty of space for entertaining, gardening, recreation, or future improvements. The covered front porch adds to the home’s curb appeal and provides a welcoming outdoor space to relax.

Conveniently located near schools, parks, shopping, restaurants, public transportation, and major commuter routes, this versatile property offers strong owner-occupant appeal as well as excellent investment potential. Whether you’re looking to expand your portfolio or live in one unit while generating rental income from the other, 760 16th Street is an opportunity you won’t want to miss. Showings begin Monday, Aug. 3rd.
